versions.changelog:
gate-info-trend-analysis 1.0.3

- Updated shared rules references for better alignment with central documentation (now use relative paths in SKILL.md).
- Clarified and simplified local maintenance flow—maintenance scripts are now optional and only referenced when present.
- Removed the legacy scripts/update-skill.sh file.
- No changes to core technical analysis workflow or tool usage.

- Maintenance and routing instructions updated for clarity and standardization.
- Explicitly documented required MCP tools, dependencies, and installation steps.
- Added authentication/credentials section, confirming no API key is needed.
- Improved maintenance flow language, simplifying update and version check policies.
- Clarified routing rules and intent checks to distinguish technical-only from multi-dimensional queries.
- No logic or workflow changes to trend analysis execution.

gate-info-trend-analysis v1.0.1

- Added update mechanism scripts (`scripts/update-skill.sh`) and references (`references/mcp.md`).
- Updated usage rules: now requires strict adherence to runtime and update check workflows before execution.
- Enhanced skill routing: use this skill only for technical/trend-only questions; route all multi-dimensional requests (e.g. including fundamentals, news) to gate-info-research.
- New explicit documentation on version check, user-confirmed skill updates, and error handling per environment.
- Updated README and documentation to reflect these stricter usage and update procedures.

- Initial release of "gate-info-trendanalysis" skill for multi-dimensional technical analysis of individual coins.
- Supports user queries related to technical indicators, trends, K-line data, support/resistance, and more.
- Integrates 4 MCP tools (K-line data, indicator history, technical signals, real-time snapshot) in parallel for comprehensive analysis.
- Automated intent recognition, routing rules, and structured technical analysis report output.
- Includes robust error handling and data-driven decision logic for signal interpretation.
